project.name: AICHD Explainable RTL Gate Count Estimator
project.purpose: Estimate Verilog RTL gate counts from source features, explain predictions, validate explanations, and expose conservative synthesis-validated optimization through a web dashboard.
project.source_of_truth: Current source and configuration; archive and historical documentation are secondary.

flow: Generated, real, or uploaded Verilog source
Lightweight validation and regex/scanner feature extraction
Yosys synthesis labels and PPA evidence
Formal equivalence and bounded combinational verification for candidates
Next.js API and Circuit Canvas dashboard output

technology_stack: Python 3.11+; local environment recorded as Python 3.13.14

components.name: Synthetic RTL generation
components.outputs: Verilog modules and generator truth CSV

components.name: Optimization verification
components.outputs: Prediction, proof status, PPA impact, optional candidate

components.name: Dashboard
components.inputs: Synced result JSON/Markdown and live API response
components.outputs: Charts, tables, inference workbench, reports, local history

data_flow: Verilog source -> BOM/comment normalization -> structural validation
Validated source -> regex/scanner features -> model feature columns
Feature columns + labels -> train/validation/test split -> RandomForest
Model + source features -> gate estimate and TreeSHAP values
SHAP rankings + mean-replacement ablation -> Spearman/Kendall/top-k faithfulness report
Source -> Yosys synthesis -> hierarchy-inclusive cell count and logic depth
Source -> rule/Yosys candidate -> formal equivalence -> bounded simulation when small combinational -> candidate synthesis -> retain only if PPA improves
Next.js API JSON -> prediction page observation/explanation/optimization/evidence/report/history tabs

algorithms.name: Recursive Boolean expression generation
algorithms.purpose: Create varied synthetic RTL while tracking gate counts

algorithms.name: Regex/scanner Verilog feature extraction
algorithms.purpose: Obtain structural, operator, complexity, and bitwidth features without a full HDL parser

algorithms.name: Yosys synthesis metrics
algorithms.outputs: Hierarchy-inclusive cell count and longest topological path

algorithms.name: Proof-gated optimization
gates: formal Yosys equivalence final success marker
bounded exhaustive simulation for <=12 input bits and combinational designs
candidate cell count or logic-depth reduction

apis.output: success, gateCount, features, shapValues, optimization/proof/PPA fields
apis.limits: Nonempty source; 500000-character maximum; 120-second Python process timeout

hardware.programming: None found. FPGA target names select synthesis mode only.

configuration.paths: Configured data, model, result, notebook, and log directories are relative to backend execution context.
configuration.secrets: No secret values included. Experimental LLM path references GEMINI_API_KEY=[REDACTED].

limitations: Yosys/Icarus-dependent tests may skip or fail when tools are unavailable
regex extraction is not a complete SystemVerilog parser
tests do not establish broad real-world model accuracy

partial_features: Real-RTL generalization is poor for large parameterized modules
Sequential optimization candidates are withheld without complete stateful proof
Some documentation and persisted research artifacts describe historical or parallel implementations
Live hosting health was not verified in this inspection
known_issues: Current extractor uses regex/scanning instead of a full HDL parser
CommandExecutor uses shell=True at an external-tool boundary
Generated results and frontend copies can become stale
Working tree contains active uncommitted edits and many temporary/generated files
No database, authentication, hardware programming, or physical signoff path
